entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Athenian Empire, a political institution in Greece during Classical Athens and the Persian Wars (461 BCE–429 BCE). Grew from Delian League and Battle of Salamis — decisive Greek naval victory over Xerxes' fleet. Led to the emergence of Peloponnesian War begins between Athens and Sparta and Athenian Sicilian Expedition ends in catastrophic defeat.
